GNURUST.DIRECTIVE.VARIANCE.ATLAS.1 non-claim: lie prevented: a COBOL binary's record bytes are fixed by the copybook alone -- NO: a COMPILER DIRECTIVE shifts them: -fbinary-size=2-4-8 makes a small COMP field 2 bytes (mis-offsetting every later field), -fbinary-byteorder=native flips multi-byte COMP endianness, and -fno-binary-truncate changes what a MOVE stores -- so a correct decode REQUIRES the producer's build profile (BUILD.PROFILE.1), it cannot be inferred from the copybook
